subtitle: Overtime Request
deadlineNote: Request overtime by 16:00 the same day. Once approved, you can enter an end time beyond the site's fixed end for that day.
deadlinePassed: Today's overtime request window has closed (until 16:00).
statusApproved: Approved (you can enter beyond the fixed end)
errorDeadline: Past the deadline (16:00 same day); cannot request.
lateNote: The 16:00 deadline has passed, but you can still report your actual overtime afterward. What you submit takes effect after admin approval.
lateReasonPlaceholder: e.g. work ran late after the deadline / reporting actual end time
lateReasonRequired: Please enter a reason for the correction.
editHint: Until the 16:00 deadline you can change or add to today's request (e.g. a second site or a break). Changes need approval again.
reapplyHint: A rejected request can be re-submitted with a reason until the 16:00 deadline.
editNote: Editing the submitted request. You can add sites or fix the end time / break. Updating requires admin approval again.
editSubmitted: Request updated. Awaiting admin approval again.
pastTitle: Correct a past day (break / end time)
pastNote: For a day before today (up to 7 days back), you can report the break you actually took or the actual end time afterwards. Once an admin approves it, that day's report hours are updated. To undo a mistake, cancel it from "Recent requests" below while it is pending; after approval, submit again for the same day (it overwrites and needs approval again).
pastReasonPlaceholder: e.g. No break on the 12th / Worked until 19:00 on the 13th
pastNothingToFix: Enter at least one of end time, early start or break.
